# Fixtures

Generated by `node tools/gen-fixtures.mjs` with OpenSSL 3.0.13 (Ubuntu 24.04).
`certs/` holds 37 test certificates (made-up names under `example.test`,
`192.0.2.0/24` and `2001:db8::/32`, all reserved for documentation); `chains/`
the 30 files the parity test reads; `openssl.json` what OpenSSL said about each
(`x509` fields, `verify -purpose sslserver -attime`, `-checkhost`/`-checkip`).
The private keys were made in a temporary directory and deleted: none is here.
Regenerating gives new keys, serials and fingerprints, so the parity numbers
stay the same but the recorded values change.
